colors.description: High-density, high-contrast, pure command-center aesthetic for SEO ops. Avoids muddy grays, relies on stark geometric lines.

layouts.general: Sidebar navigation (left) + Main Content area (right). Full screen height (h-screen) with internal scrolling for main content.
layouts.spacing_strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards). Base grid: grid-cols-12. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use padding p-4 to p-6 for internal card spacing.
layouts.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-[#141414]), 1px solid border (border-[#262626]), no shadow. Sharp corners or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm).
layouts.data_density: Compact rows for tables (32px-40px height). Cap tables at 6-8 visible columns to avoid horizontal scroll fatigue.

components.sidebar: Fixed left width (e.g., 250px). Must feature clear active states and distinct 'disabled/coming soon' visual styling (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed).
components.demo_banner: Sticky top banner across the main layout. Background Warning Yellow, Text Black. 'DEMO DATA ACTIVE'.
components.cards: Cardless or minimalist rectangular borders. DO NOT OVERUSE SHADOWS. Structure hierarchy via 1px borders.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Monospace fonts for all numeric data (tabular-nums utility). Color-coded trend indicators (red/green arrows).
components.drawers: Use Shadcn Sheet for the 'evidence drawer' and 'drill-down' instead of navigating to new pages. Keeps the user in the context of the War Room.
components.gauges: Use Recharts (PieChart with 180 start/end angle) or custom SVG for the Cost Ledger budget gauge ($100/mo cap).
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for switching between AU War Room / NZ War Room, or Agent Activity / Memory.

motion.philosophy: Minimalist and immediate. Functional feedback only.
motion.hover_states: Slight background lightness increase (hover:bg-[#262626]). NEVER lose text contrast.

visual_enhancers.grid_borders: The 'Technical' Look. Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse layout, items have border-b and border-r.
visual_enhancers.textures: No glossy elements. Matte finish. A very subtle noise overlay (opacity 2%) on the main background can be used if pure flat feels too dead.
visual_enhancers.data_visualization: Recharts for trend lines. Clean, stroke-based charts (no fill gradients) to match the precise, technical vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx extensions for all React components. Do not use .tsx.
Install fonts: 'npm install @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans @fontsource/jetbrains-mono' or use standard web imports.
Use lucide-react for sharp, technical icons.
Modify index.css to enforce the Deep Obsidian dark mode palette globally. Hardcode dark mode colors into the :root or .dark layer.
Remove default centering from App.css (delete .App, .App-header styles).
Create a reusable Metric Card component that accepts: Title, Value (mono), Trend/Delta, and Drilldown onClick handler.
Implement the '0-100 Opportunity Score' with a colored pill/badge: Red (<50), Yellow (50-79), Green (80-100).
For tables, align numeric columns to the right and use the 'tabular-nums' Tailwind class.
Build a robust Layout component containing the Sidebar and a Main scrollable area.
Ensure the 'DEMO DATA' banner is highly visible, fixed at the top of the layout.
Avoid transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, select menus, or drawers. Always use Solid #141414 with a 1px border-border.
Use Recharts for the Cost Ledger gauge and keyword trend lines.
Construct deep drill-downs: clicking a table row MUST open a Shadcn Sheet showing evidence/agent memory.
Generate realistic mock data (e.g., real AU/NZ Shopify products, SEO metrics like 'Cannibalization Risk'). No lorem ipsum.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic by ensuring strict alignment, tight grids, and precise typography.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to flat, solid matte colors.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use flex/grid for structural, left-aligned, optical alignments.
Create depth through 1px borders and distinct surface hex codes (#0A0A0A vs #141414), not soft box-shadows.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings with focus:ring-2).
Missing categories = you will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use realistic domain names, actual agent roles, and real SEO terminology.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-link').
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Metric-trend-detail hierarchy: Surface headline KPIs first, then provide drill-down capabilities.
Right-hand drawer pattern: Use sheets/drawers for detail views instead of full page reloads to maintain dashboard context.
Tabular numerals: Always use monospaced fonts for quantitative data to ensure vertical alignment and quick scanning.
Accessible contrast: Text must meet a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the background. Do not use dark gray text on black backgrounds.
Semantic color limits: Only use vibrant colors (Red, Green, Yellow, Blue) to signal status, alerts, or actionable links. Keep the structural UI monochrome.
State persistence: Ensure the UI clearly shows the active state (e.g., which tab is active, which sidebar item is selected).

media.icons: lucide-react (default). Use solid/sharp variants where possible.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. Pure White/Off-White text on Obsidian backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: Mandatory on all buttons, links, table rows, and form inputs for end-to-end testing.
